description: Production HF/PEFT backend runtime policy. Every value that changes what the backend executes lives here, so the resolved config hash covers it. Model revisions themselves are NOT here: they are per-model identities carried by manifests/models/<alias>.json and stay UNRESOLVED_NOT_DOWNLOADED until acquisition [AUTH: 01 §8G].

backend_version.note: Bumped whenever the executable backend contract changes.

model_loader.note: 01 §8C. One canonical production loader for the locked text-only research path.

training_precision.note: 01 §10. Training and ordinary model forward run in BF16 on the H100 profile. Scientific merge/recovery arithmetic is separately frozen at float32; statistics accumulate in float64.

forward_precision.note: 01 §10. The scoring forward pass. Recorded explicitly rather than left to an autocast default.

statistic_precision.note: 01 §10. Token-level reductions accumulate in float64; the backend never returns a bf16 scalar as a statistic.

fixture_precision.note: CPU fixture profile. Structurally distinct from the H100 production profile and refused on an evidentiary path.

permitted_precisions.note: 01 §10. float16 is not permitted for the research path; see forbidden_load_options for quantized modes.

forbidden_load_options.note: 01 §8C. A checkpoint that requires quantization fails compatibility; it is never silently substituted.

device_fallback_policy.note: 01 §12. A requested device or dtype that is unavailable raises; it never degrades quietly to another one.

trust_remote_code.note: 01 §8C. Version-controlled and false by default. A model whose architecture genuinely requires remote code must have that recorded here before it can load.

local_files_only.note: Scientifically immaterial: it controls where bytes come from, not what is computed. True by default so no evidentiary path reaches the network implicitly.

attn_implementation.note: 01 §12. Pinned so a kernel change cannot move the logits without moving the backend identity.

architecture_mapping_version.note: 01 §8B. Bumped whenever any family's module mapping changes; bound into every adapter manifest.

peft_task_type.note: 01 §8B. The research path is a causal language model.

peft_bias_policy.note: 01 §8B. Biases are not adapted; the induced update is exactly ΔW = BA.

lora_scaling_rule.note: PEFT's own semantics: scaling = lora_alpha / r, applied exactly once when the induced update is formed. use_rslora is not enabled.

use_rslora.note: Rank-stabilised scaling would change the induced update; disabled so lora_scaling_rule is the whole rule.

adapter_weight_filename.note: The PEFT save layout the production persistence path reads and writes.

lora_factor_suffixes.note: PEFT's factor tensor naming. Exactly one A and one B per target; anything else is refused.

peft_module_prefix.note: PEFT prefixes every wrapped module; stripped to recover the canonical base parameter name.

truncation_policy.note: 02 §C7. Bound into the tokenizer identity; a change moves the cache key.

loss_mask_policy.note: 00 §14.1, §14.2. The scored record is the continuation; padding and the unshiftable first position are excluded and nothing else is.

causal_shift.note: The standard causal-LM alignment: position t's logits predict token t+1.

dp_secondary_alias.note: 01 §8E. Secondary only if the DP compatibility smoke later passes without changing any frozen scientific rule.

dp_engine.note: 01 §8E. The production per-sample gradient engine. This task wires it; it runs no DP training.

backend_integrated.note: 02 §C6. Stays false until backend contract execution, the full synthetic rerun, cache assertions, H100 GPU smoke and the 1,000-sequence benchmark have all passed.

fallback_target_policy_authorized.note: 01 §8B.1. LANGUAGE_TRUNK_ALL_COMMON_LINEAR remains gated on the P0-A measurement-power condition and is not activated by this backend.

c1_exact_inversion_limit.note: 00 §25 P0-C1. The compatibility contract's inversion row reuses the already-frozen S08 criterion rather than inventing a second one.
